Under that, three equal cards: Fan + cover $250, Content $150, Tripod $99, each with a short line and a Select button. Then a strip of small specs: Ø 42 cm, 1024 × 800 px, 224 LEDs, 150° viewing, 20 W.

Clean grid, generous spacing, premium tech feel. Not a poster: a working web page with legible links, text and buttons.
